deep.reconstruction: There is no mathematics on this page. Folio 45v is the blank verso of a library borrowing slip. The faint, reversed brown writing is show-through (bleed) of the recto, folio 45r, whose transcription is the 'previous page'. It reads, mirrored: 'Liouville, Journal de mathématiques, T. 17. Paris 1852 / T. 18. Paris 1853 / T. 20. Paris 1855', and lower left the signature 'B Riemann' with an address in parentheses. That address is most likely '(Weststr.)', matching 'Weststraße' on the next slip, folio 46. The slip records Riemann borrowing volumes 17, 18 and 20 of Liouville's Journal, probably from the Göttingen library. Folio 46 is a parallel slip for Poggendorff's Annalen dated Febr. 25, 59. Apart from the bleed-through, the page shows only a small red mark at the right, a paper crease at the top, and a light blue-green stain at the left margin. Nothing is derived or computed.

results.what: Library loan record: Riemann borrowed Liouville's Journal de mathématiques pures et appliquées, vols. 17 (1852), 18 (1853), 20 (1855). The text is visible here only as bleed-through from the recto.

deep.surprise_reason: The page is blank apart from mirror-image show-through of a library borrowing slip on the recto. There is no mathematical content. That Riemann read Liouville's Journal of the 1850s is unremarkable.
transcription_corrections: The writing on 45v is not original text. It is reversed bleed-through of folio 45r and should be recorded as show-through, not as a separate text.
'Avril 1852', 'Janv 1853', 'Juin 1855' are misreadings of the mirrored 'Paris 1852', 'Paris 1853', 'Paris 1855', as on the recto.

'Hermite (Wolf)' is a misreading of the mirrored signature 'B Riemann' and the address in parentheses. The address is most likely '(Weststr.)', consistent with 'Weststraße' on folio 46, rather than '(Weg̃str.)'.
